invariants.claim: Replacing any header field changes its challenge; malformed transaction bytes reject without nonce or balance authority.

invariants.atomic: Decode is pure and bounded; signature verification and state publication are later independent boundaries.
cuts: Truncation, trailing bytes, zero nonce, unknown tag
invariants.threat: Encoding ambiguity, cross-genesis replay and unsafe unversioned upgrades.
invariants.remaining: Third-party verifier and production upgrade policy remain unaccepted.

invariants.claim: Bad signatures reject the whole block without mutating parent state; altered work output or context never yields verified work.
invariants.scope: Actual strict native signatures and unchanged experimental transcript verification.
invariants.atomic: Signature verification precedes speculative patches; only full transcript verification creates work authority.

invariants.limit: 49188-byte work certificate; failed proof still requires substantial computation.
invariants.threat: Cheap forgery amplification, structured-input shortcuts, hardware advantage and weak-key disagreement.
invariants.remaining: Cost hardness and public Sybil-safe proof admission are not established by queue limits.

invariants.remaining: Native P2P consensus actor, timestamp attack qualification and independently operated network are pending.

invariants.remaining: Normal Hepta final-use token, independent rollback frontier and target-side reconciliation remain unjoined.

invariants.remaining: Global public fairness and cheap-proof defense are unresolved; local recovery capability is never selected by packet fields.

invariants.atomic: Validate exact key reads and prefix-scan results immediately before canonical patch commit.

invariants.remaining: Future-nonce parking, replacement policy and mempool reorg events still require native host integration.
